title: Read-only help and early flag validation

acceptance.text: Help preserves target bytes; unknown and conflicting flags fail before dispatch; recovery flags remain valid.
Installed and direct CLI entrypoints retain dispatch compatibility.

title: Ignore supervision without hiding user changes

acceptance.text: Supervision ignore is idempotent; tracked runtime files are diagnosed without index mutation.
Runtime noise remains distinguished from source and user modifications.
Active workers, integration and waiting states render deterministically without undefined.
Clearing integration status does not claim successful integration.

title: Browser launch causes and server identity

acceptance.text: Browser failures retain redacted causes; production requires pinned served-source identity and rejects foreign servers.
Multi-step journeys and existing source-bound smoke evidence remain enforced.
Read-only preflight separates configuration, availability and unverified host activation.
Native RTK schema is used without duplicate legacy hooks or deletion of foreign hooks.
MCP deadlines and shutdown are bounded, including native Windows cleanup.

title: Retain proofs and reject dirty completion

acceptance.text: Hashed source/config/environment-bound evidence survives cleanup; escapes and corruption block integration.
Serial and parallel completion changes are preserved and block success rather than being auto-committed.

title: Actual write scopes and isolated caches

acceptance.text: Shared writable runtime caches are blocked before gates; package-level pnpm links remain allowed.
Candidate diffs reject undeclared writes, sibling collisions and post-rebase gate drift.
Coverage, deduplication, partial usage, interval sums/unions and failure roles retain unknown values.
Local usage and tool diagnostics require no model call or target mutation.
Release metadata discovery and README synchronization stay deterministic.
Served-source identity is checked before browser launch and after journeys.
